It learns all skills of Lv20 or below from the 24 classes (about 120 skills) and gets no class awakening. Ye Xiu plays 君莫笑 Lord Grim (Happy); the account was first built by Su Muqiu. Its silver weapon 千机伞 Myriad Manifestation Umbrella switches form with no weapon-swap cooldown. At Lv80 it has 12 forms plus a Mechanical Box. Fighter: Claw, Tonfa. Gunner: Gatling Gun, Mechanical Box. Mage: Magic Staff, Battle Lance. Night Walker: Magic Staff, Ninjato, Dual Swords. Priest: War Scythe, Shield, Knight's Sword. Swordsman: Tachi, Broadsword. Dual Swords, Broadsword and Claw were added at Lv80. Each form grants +1 SP. The Exorcist's Lv75 Seal Talisman can seal it for 60s.
core_mechanics: All of the researcher's core mechanics are kept. Spot-checks against fandom agree: 24 classes in 6 groups of 4, every Lv1 skill is a knock-up, grabs break super armor, Guard blocks physical but not magic, the shield block rule, weapon attack-speed values, and the Lv75 cap update.
Glory is a first-person 3D action MMO with heavy DNF influence, played on keyboard and mouse. APM matters.
Stats: STR, INT, VIT, Spirit, plus HP and MP. Skills cost MP and have cooldowns. No potions in pro matches.

Weapon-gated skills, weapon swap cooldown, any Lv20-or-below skill learnable before changing class at Lv20. Level cap 70, raised to 75. Equipment tiers end in self-made Silver gear. Equipment weight affects move speed, attack speed and jump height.

Weapon attack speeds per fandom: Greatsword 1, Broadsword 3, Short Sword 5, Tachi 7, Lightsaber 9, Revolver 7-8 (6 shots), Automatic Pistol 10 (8 shots), Rifle 2-3 (penetrating), Hand Cannon slowest (single shot then reload).

Launch/float and air juggles; knockdown with quick recovery; grabs and some knockdowns negate quick recovery; OTG attacks hit downed targets; a system protection limits infinite juggles (exact numbers not in canon).
Hitstun with start-up and end lag; priority clashes between attacks.
Super armor: immune to displacement and stun but still takes damage. Grabs and armor break remove it.
Block, parry and reflect counters (Guard, Shield, Empty-Handed Blade Block, Shield Counter, Spell Reflect, Magic Mirror).
Status effects: stun, dizzy, freeze, slow, root, silence, sleep, blind, confusion, taunt, bleed/poison/burn, weight increase. Attacks from behind deal bonus damage.
Movement tech: double jump, aerial fire with gun recoil, flight (broom, rotor wings, angel wings), stealth, teleport, underground travel, and terrain height bonuses.
PvE: aggro and tank/healer/DPS roles. 5-player dungeons with speed-clear records. Bosses enrage at 'red blood' (10% HP). Wild bosses are contested by guilds.

Pro league: Individual (3 x 1v1, 1 point each), Group Arena (3 players, winner stays on, 2 points), Team (5v5 plus 1 sub, 5 points). The home team picks the map, which is hidden until the match starts.
Account cards hold characters. God-level account titles: 斗神, 剑圣, 枪王, 拳皇, 魔术师.
